name: rss2json
rate_limits: Limited free requests without API key (undocumented exact cap); returns 10 items per feed by default; sorting/count require API key
notes: Converts any RSS or Atom feed URL into structured JSON via a simple GET request. Pass feed URL as ?rss_url= parameter. No auth required for basic use. Useful for AI because it enables programmatic consumption of any RSS feed (news outlets, blogs, government feeds) without XML parsing. Normalizes disparate feed formats into consistent JSON structure with title, pubDate, link, content, thumbnail, categories. Can be combined with any news outlet's RSS feed for a completely free, unlimited news pipeline.
